description: This file defines the ManyToOne class, a plugin for handling many-to-one relationship arguments within Drupal Views module. It includes methods for initializing, defining options, building form UI, ensuring database tables, constructing queries, and generating titles for the argument handler.

classes.name: ManyToOne
classes.description: A plugin class for handling many-to-one relationship arguments in Drupal Views, providing configuration, query building, and display title functionalities.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the view, display, and options, and sets up the helper and default operator and value.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines configurable options for the argument handler, including 'break_phrase', 'add_table', and 'require_value'.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the form for configuring options, including checkboxes for multiple values, multiple filter work, and hiding items with no value.

methods.name: ensureMyTable
methods.description: Ensures the database table for the argument is set up.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds the query based on the argument, handling empty values and applying filters.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Generates a human-readable title for the argument based on its value.

methods.name: summaryQuery
methods.description: Prepares the summary query, including table joins and fields.

methods.name: summaryArgument
methods.description: Returns the argument value for summary purposes.

methods.name: titleQuery
methods.description: Returns the current value for title display.
